d:
Yemen's Houthi movement has claimed responsibility for two military operations targeting Saudi Arabia's Jeddah and Jazan ports on November 25, 2026. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said both strikes successfully hit their intended targets, causing damage to the sites.
The Houthis also warned Saudi Arabia against any aggression targeting Yemen's Hodeidah port, threatening an immediate response and further military action.
Watch for the latest developments in the escalating tensions between Yemen's Houthis and Saudi Arabia.
